cases.title: Verify both Classic and Modern themes exist under themes preferences
cases.description: Navigate to the themes preferences and verify that both Classic and Modern themes are present and listed.

cases.title: Verify Classic theme display
cases.description: Verify that the Classic theme is displayed correctly as shown in the given image.

cases.title: Verify Modern theme display against reference image
cases.description: Navigate to the Modern theme and verify that it is displayed correctly as shown in the given image.

cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences item under View menu
cases.description: Navigate to the View menu and verify that the 'Theme Preferences' item is available.

cases.title: Verify Get New Themes under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the Get New Themes item is available.

cases.title: Verify Classic item under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Classic' item is present and available.

cases.title: Verify Modern item under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and confirm that the 'Modern' menu item is present and available.

opinions.feedback: The proposed test cases adequately cover all requirements without any blocking issues regarding testability, distinct scenarios, or risk.

analysis.analysis: For R-175: Normal scenario is navigating to themes preferences to verify that both Classic and Modern themes exist. For R-176: Normal scenario is verifying that the Classic theme is displayed as in the given image. For R-177: Normal scenario is verifying that the Modern theme is displayed as in the given image. For R-178: Normal scenario is verifying that the Theme Preferences item is available under the View menu. For R-179: Normal scenario is verifying that the Get New Themes item is available under the View menu. For R-180: Normal scenario is verifying that the Classic item is available under the View menu. For R-181: Normal scenario is verifying that the Modern item is available under the View menu.
